title: 38 Of confyrmation and conſecration of the perſons elected.

segments.text: COncerning the confyrmation & conſecratiō of the perſon elected it was done by laying handes vpon the head of him which was elected, & commendyng him to the Lord by the prayers of all the Churche whiche were there aſſembled: which ceremony hath ben vſed from the law of Moiſes & after retained and vſed by Ieſus Chriſt & by the apoſtles. Neuertheles in the election of biſhops, this was added by the auncient Canons that the nexte Byſhops ſhould be there at the leaſt, to the number of thrée with the metropolitane.
